 592|        parts.append(
 593|            "\n\n**ACTION**: Address ALL the feedback above. "
 594|            "Make focused, specific improvements. Then call request_review again "
 595|            "to submit the revised work for re-evaluation."
 596|        )
 597|
 598|        return "\n".join(parts)

 603|# ============================================================================
 604|
 605|class PhaseReviewGate:
 606|    """Orchestrates human review at development phase boundaries.
 607|
 608|    Usage in DevAgentCore:
 609|        gate = PhaseReviewGate(llm_client, streaming_server, session_manager)
 610|        review_session = await gate.submit_for_review(
 611|            phase="implementation",
 612|            title="User authentication module",
 613|            summary="Implemented login, registration, and JWT session management",
 614|            artifacts=[...],
 615|            workspace="./project"
 616|        )
 617|        decision = await review_session.wait_for_decision()
 618|        if decision["decision"] == "approve":
 619|            # proceed to next phase
 620|        elif decision["decision"] == "revise":
 621|            # inject feedback and redo
 622|    """
 623|
 624|    def __init__(self, llm_client=None, streaming_server=None,
 625|                 session_manager=None, terminal_channel=None):
 626|        self.llm = llm_client
 627|        self.streaming = streaming_server
 628|        self.session_mgr = session_manager
 629|        self.evaluator = QualityEvaluator(llm_client)
 630|        self.formatter = ReviewFormatter()
 631|        self.terminal = terminal_channel
 632|        self._thread_channel = None  # Set by API endpoint for bg thread mode
 633|
 634|        # Active review sessions
 635|        self._active_session: Optional[ReviewSession] = None
 636|        self._review_history: list[ReviewRequest] = []
 637|
 638|    @property
 639|    def has_active_review(self) -> bool:
 640|        return self._active_session is not None and not self._active_session.is_resolved
 641|
 642|    def get_active_session(self) -> Optional[ReviewSession]:
 643|        return self._active_session
 644|
 645|    async def submit_for_review(self, phase: str, title: str, summary: str,
 646|                                 artifacts: list[ReviewArtifact],
 647|                                 task_id: str = "",
 648|                                 workspace: str = ".",
 649|                                 quality_self_assessment: str = "",
 650|                                 timeout_seconds: int = 600) -> ReviewSession:
 651|        """Submit work for human review. Blocks until evaluation completes.
 652|
 653|        Args:
 654|            phase: "exploration" / "implementation" / "testing" / "fix" / "delivery"
 655|            title: Short title of what was done
 656|            summary: Agent's own summary of work
 657|            artifacts: List of ReviewArtifacts
 658|            task_id: Task identifier
 659|            workspace: Workspace path
 660|            quality_self_assessment: Agent's self-assessment
 661|            timeout_seconds: Max wait time for human response
 662|
 663|        Returns:
 664|            ReviewSession with formatted review doc and decision
 665|        """
 666|        request = ReviewRequest(
 667|            id=f"rev_{task_id}_{int(time.time())}",
 668|            phase=phase,
 669|            title=title,
 670|            summary=summary,
 671|            artifacts=artifacts,
 672|            quality_self_assessment=quality_self_assessment,
 673|        )
 674|
 675|        session = ReviewSession(request, self.evaluator, timeout_seconds)
 676|        self._active_session = session
 677|
 678|        # Run quality evaluation
 679|        formatted = await session.run_evaluation(workspace)
 680|
 681|        # PRIORITY 1: Thread channel (background agent)
 682|        if self._thread_channel:
 683|            quality = request.quality_score.value if request.quality_score else "unknown"
 684|            req = self._thread_channel.create_review(
 685|                phase=phase, title=title, summary=summary,
 686|                quality_score=quality, timeout=timeout_seconds,
 687|            )
 688|            result = req.wait(timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds + 5)
 689|            self._thread_channel._pending.pop(req.id, None)
 690|            session.resolve(
 691|                result.get("decision", "approve"),
 692|                result.get("feedback", ""),
 693|                result.get("suggestions", []),
 694|            )
 695|            return session
 696|
 697|        # Check if WS clients are connected
 698|        has_clients = (self.session_mgr and
 699|                       self.session_mgr.get_connected_count(task_id) > 0)
 700|
 701|        if has_clients:
 702|            # Push review document to streaming channel
 703|            if self.streaming:
 704|                await self.streaming.push_event({
 705|                    "type": "review.requested",
 706|                    "task_id": task_id,
 707|                    "data": {
 708|                        "review_id": request.id,
 709|                        "phase": phase,
 710|                        "title": title,
 711|                        "summary": summary,
 712|                        "quality_score": request.quality_score.value if request.quality_score else "unknown",
 713|                        "markdown": formatted.markdown,
 714|                        "artifact_count": formatted.artifact_count,
 715|                        "status": "pending",
 716|                    },
 717|                    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
 718|                })
 719|
 720|            # Broadcast to session clients
 721|            if self.session_mgr:
 722|                await self.session_mgr.broadcast(task_id, {
 723|                    "type": "review.requested",
 724|                    "data": {
 725|                        "review_id": request.id,
 726|                        "phase": phase,
 727|                        "title": title,
 728|                        "quality_score": request.quality_score.value if request.quality_score else "unknown",
 729|                        "markdown": formatted.markdown[:5000],
 730|                        "markdown_full_length": len(formatted.markdown),
 731|                    },
 732|                })
 733|
 734|        elif self.terminal and self.terminal.available:
 735|            # Terminal-based review
 736|            quality = request.quality_score.value if request.quality_score else "unknown"
 737|            quality_icons = {
 738|                "meets_standard": "✅", "needs_minor_fixes": "🔧",
 739|                "needs_major_rework": "⚠️", "critical_failure": "❌",
 740|            }
 741|            icon = quality_icons.get(quality, "❓")
 742|
 743|            print(f"\n  Quality: {icon} {quality}")
 744|            print(f"  Summary: {summary[:300]}")
 745|            print(f"  Artifacts: {len(artifacts)}")
 746|
 747|            decision = await self.terminal.prompt_review(
 748|                request.id, phase, title, quality, timeout_seconds
 749|            )
 750|            session.resolve(
 751|                decision["decision"],
 752|                decision.get("feedback", ""),
 753|                decision.get("suggestions", []),
 754|            )
 755|
 756|        else:
 757|            # No interaction channel — auto-approve immediately (non-blocking)
 758|            session.resolve("approve", "Auto-approved (no interaction channel available)")
 759|
 760|        return session
 761|
 762|    def resolve_review(self, review_id: str, decision: str,
 763|                       feedback: str = "", suggestions: list[str] = None):
 764|        """Resolve an active review with human decision.
 765|
 766|        Args:
 767|            review_id: The review ID
 768|            decision: "approve", "revise", or "reject"
 769|            feedback: Human feedback text
 770|            suggestions: Specific actionable items
 771|        """
 772|        if not self._active_session:
 773|            return False
 774|
 775|        if self._active_session.request.id != review_id:
 776|            return False
 777|
 778|        self._active_session.resolve(decision, feedback, suggestions)
 779|        self._review_history.append(self._active_session.request)
 780|
 781|        # Push resolution event
 782|        event_data = {
 783|            "review_id": review_id,
 784|            "decision": decision,
 785|            "feedback": feedback[:500],
 786|        }
 787|
 788|        if self.streaming:
 789|            import asyncio as _asyncio
 790|            try:
 791|                loop = _asyncio.get_event_loop()
 792|                if loop.is_running():
 793|                    _asyncio.ensure_future(
 794|                        self.streaming.push_event({
 795|                            "type": "review.resolved",
 796|                            "data": event_data,
 797|                            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
 798|                        })
 799|                    )
 800|            except RuntimeError:
 801|                pass
 802|
 803|        return True
 804|
 805|    def get_revision_context(self) -> str:
 806|        """Get the revision context for the active session."""
 807|        if not self._active_session:
 808|            return ""
 809|        return self._active_session.build_revision_context()
 810|
 811|    def get_review_history(self) -> list[dict]:
 812|        """Get review history summary."""
 813|        return [
 814|            {
 815|                "id": r.id,
 816|                "phase": r.phase,
 817|                "title": r.title,
 818|                "status": r.status.value,
 819|                "quality": r.quality_score.value if r.quality_score else "unknown",
 820|                "created": r.created_at[:19],
 821|                "responded": r.responded_at[:19] if r.responded_at else "",
 822|                "decision": r.human_decision.value if r.human_decision else "",
 823|            }
 824|            for r in self._review_history
 825|        ]
 826|
 827|    def clear_active(self):
 828|        """Clear the active session after resolution."""
 829|        if self._active_session and self._active_session.is_resolved:
 830|            self._active_session = None

 837|class ArtifactBuilder:
 838|    """Build ReviewArtifact instances from common patterns."""
 839|
 840|    @staticmethod
 841|    def from_code_files(files: list[str], description: str = "",
 842|                        workspace: str = ".") -> ReviewArtifact:
 843|        """Build from a list of code file paths."""
 844|        metrics = {"file_count": len(files)}
 845|        preview = ""
 846|        for f in files[:2]:
 847|            fpath = os.path.join(workspace, f) if not os.path.isabs(f) else f
 848|            try:
 849|                content = Path(fpath).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
 850|                metrics[f"lines_{os.path.basename(f)}"] = len(content.split("\n"))
 851|                if not preview and content:
 852|                    preview = content[:1500]
 853|            except Exception:
 854|                pass
 855|        return ReviewArtifact(
 856|            artifact_type=ArtifactType.CODE,
 857|            description=description or f"Source code: {len(files)} file(s)",
 858|            file_paths=files,
 859|            content_preview=preview,
 860|            metrics=metrics,
 861|        )
 862|
 863|    @staticmethod
 864|    def from_test_results(test_files: list[str], test_results: dict,
 865|                          description: str = "") -> ReviewArtifact:
 866|        """Build from test files and their execution results."""
 867|        return ReviewArtifact(
 868|            artifact_type=ArtifactType.TEST,
 869|            description=description or f"Test suite: {len(test_files)} file(s)",
 870|            file_paths=test_files,
 871|            test_results=test_results,
 872|            metrics={
 873|                "test_files": len(test_files),
 874|                "passed": test_results.get("passed", 0),
 875|                "failed": test_results.get("failed", 0),
 876|                "collected": test_results.get("collected", 0),
 877|            },
 878|        )
 879|
 880|    @staticmethod
 881|    def from_diff(modified_files: list[str], diff_text: str,
 882|                  description: str = "") -> ReviewArtifact:
 883|        """Build from a git diff."""
 884|        return ReviewArtifact(
 885|            artifact_type=ArtifactType.DIFF,
 886|            description=description or f"Changes: {len(modified_files)} file(s)",
 887|            file_paths=modified_files,
 888|            diff_summary=diff_text[:3000],
 889|            metrics={"files_changed": len(modified_files),
 890|                     "diff_lines": len(diff_text.split("\n"))},
 891|        )

 893|    @staticmethod
 894|    def from_plan(plan_data: dict, description: str = "") -> ReviewArtifact:

 896|        sub_tasks = plan_data.get("sub_tasks", [])
